dogecoin.text: I think @Dogecoin would be fixed pegged against dollar somewhere in $1 to $3 range once dogecoin reaches or exceeds this range. This would prevent flash crash and enable widespread adoption making it the first alt currency. Time frame - 3 years. Govt. support likely.

@ProTheDoge Since Doge has inflation built-in, there need to be some mechanism to prevent price crash for #dogecoin in its journey to be the alt currency. Large scale adoption along with regulatory support is required. This would also help large scale conversion from other alt-coins.

@davidgokhshtein The bull run might have started on news of Amazon accepting crypto payments by year end. We are going to see lot of spikes in #Bitcoin , #Dogecoin and #Ethereum as more businesses accept crypto.
#dogecoin supply and its community are its main strength!

@CEOAdam IMO, you should do it and evaluate after a couple of quarters the sales volume in 5 cryptos. I am sure #Dogecoin would beat others hands down. People can afford it, it has a strong community and rational supply and it is backed by Elon and VB!
@davidgokhshtein #shibainu growth shows it would compete with #Bitcoin and #Ethereum to be future savings account of people! Hopefully #dogecoin would become the checking account.
@MattWallace888 #dogecoin is future checking account while #shibainu is the future savings account of earth!

@davidgokhshtein $Doge breaking $1 is a real possibility this year. Subsequently it would likely have a slow and decreasing net demand driven increase (based on adoption and supply) in value going forward (may be in the range of 3-15% yearly)
